title: Zesty Romantic Japanese Jumbo Shrimp Inari Zushi
description: A resinous and creamy Japanese dish featuring jumbo shrimp, beurre-monte, and sugar-free friendly ingredients, formed into inarizushi
instructions: Prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions and season with salt and sesame oil
Cut the beurre-monte into small pieces and melt in a saucepan over low heat
Add the sweetened soy sauce, grated ginger, and cooked jumbo shrimp to the saucepan and stir to combine
Cook the shrimp mixture for 2-3 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and fully cooked
Prepare the aburaage tofu pouches by cutting them in half and rinsing with cold water
Fill each tofu pouch with a small amount of sushi rice and a piece of the cooked shrimp mixture
Serve the inarizushi immediately and garnish with additional grated ginger if desired
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours
